articles.title: Petrol, diesel prices largely stable on Tuesday, 17 November: Check how much fuel costs in New Delhi, Mumbai
articles.titleEn: Petrol, diesel prices largely stable on Tuesday, 17 November: Check how much fuel costs in New Delhi, Mumbai
articles.summary: Petrol and diesel prices remained unchanged across major Indian cities on November 17, even as the Centre raised diesel and ATF export levies. Union Minister Suresh Gopi said an immediate fuel price cut was not possible, citing losses of ₹42,000 crore incurred by oil companies.
